en: Black-and-white postcard view of a leafy park or garden walkway with several white slatted benches along a dirt path. On the right is a wooden pavilion or veranda attached to a light-colored building, with decorative railings and posts. Trees and bushes line the path, and a single person walks in the distance. In the lower-left corner, the place name is printed in white lettering.
